title: Project Unfiltered: A Safe Place to Talk Growing Up
benefit_note: The session was fruitful and informative. Also, it helped our club in international exposure.
objectives: The Objectives are as follows:
details:
With the aim of spreading the awareness to empower teenagers to understand themselves better, break social taboos, and build healthier, more confident lives, we Rotaract Club of Metro City collaborated with the Rotaract Club of Social Crew of RID 3250 and organized a session on Physical Health and Personal Hygiene under the Project Unfiltered led by Dr. Dikshya Acharya.

The session covered key areas such as mental health and emotional well-being, confidence, consent and communication, and the importance of seeking help. It also included open conversations on body changes during adolescence menstruation, mood swings, and physical development for girls, and voice cracks, facial hair, and societal pressures for boys reinforcing that these changes are completely normal.

With the aim of empowering teenagers, the project encouraged participants to understand themselves better, break social taboos, and build healthier, more confident lives.

title: Feeding Hope: Joint Animal Welfare Initiative by Twin Clubs
benefit_note: The project strengthened cooperation between both clubs and supported OXSA with essential food supplies.Members gained awareness of animal welfare and the challenges of running a shelter.The initiative fostered compassion, responsibility, and a broader sense of community service.
objectives:
The initiative aimed to:

Support the welfare of animals under OXSA’s care

Promote awareness about animal rights and animal-related humanitarian service

Encourage members to participate in service projects beyond human-centric causes

Strengthen bonds between twin clubs through meaningful collaboration
details:
OXSA Nepal is an animal shelter dedicated to the rescue, care, and protection of animals—mainly dogs, cats, and birds. Currently, the shelter houses 22 dogs, 1 cat, and 1 crow, providing them with food, shelter, and necessary healthcare services.

On 24th August 2025, Rotaract Club of Metro City , jointly with its twin club Rotaract Club of Metrocity, successfully organised an OXSA Donation Programme .Members from both clubs actively participated, showcasing unity, service spirit, and shared commitment to animal welfare.As a gesture of support and compassion, RAC Durbarmarg and RAC Metrocity jointly donated:

2 packs of rice (25 kg each)

5 kg of lentils

2 crates of eggs

The total cost of these items was equally shared between both clubs. This contribution helped fulfil the nutritional needs of the animals and supported the shelter in managing its daily operations.

During the visit, members from both clubs interacted with the caretaker of OXSA Nepal. They learned about:

The day-to-day challenges of running an animal shelter

The health and nutritional needs of the animals

The importance of continuous community involvement and donations

This meaningful exchange deepened members’ understanding and compassion towards animal welfare.
sdgs: End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture

title: 14th Installation Ceremony
benefit_note: Conducting an installation ceremony helps formally transition leadership and recognize incoming board members. It also strengthens club unity, renews commitment, and showcases the club’s vision to members and guests.
objectives: To officially induct new president, board of directors and members, marking the formal beginning of the new tenure (RY 2025-26).
details:
The 14th Installation Ceremony of the Rotaract Club of Metro City was a dignified and well-organized event held to officially transfer leadership responsibilities and celebrate the achievements of the club. The program commenced with the arrival and acknowledgment of distinguished guests, including club leaders, district officials, and respected invitees. Following the National and Rotary anthems, the lighting of the Panas symbolized the formal inauguration of the ceremony. A warm welcome address and a graceful cultural performance added vibrance and warmth to the occasion.

Outgoing President Rtr. Sweta Shrestha delivered a comprehensive annual report outlining the club’s initiatives and achievements over the past year. Certificates of appreciation were then awarded to board members and contributors in recognition of their dedication and service. The incoming President Rtr. Anusha Pandey was formally introduced, took her oath of office, and was presented with the club’s insignia — including the charter certificate, collar, gong, and gavel — representing the official transfer of leadership. In her acceptance speech, she shared her vision for the coming year and announced the newly appointed board members, who also took their oaths and received badges and identification cards.

The ceremony further featured the induction of new members, remarks from dignitaries, and special acknowledgments honoring the contributions of the outgoing president. Tokens of appreciation were distributed to guests and supporters as a gesture of gratitude. Ending on a gracious note, a vote of thanks was delivered, followed by a formal toast for national and international harmony and goodwill. The event concluded with the adjournment by the newly installed president and informal fellowship over refreshments.

The ceremony exemplified the club’s commitment to leadership development, continuity of service, and a strengthened spirit of Rotaract camaraderie.
goals: Empower and Engage Members IN PROGRESS 75%

title: Grant Management Seminar
benefit_note: Participation in the Grant Management Seminar improved the club’s competence in identifying, applying for, and managing Rotary grants, thereby increasing the potential for well-planned, transparent, and high-impact community projects in the coming Rotary Year.
objectives:
To enhance members’ understanding of Rotary grant opportunities, including District and Global Grants.

To build capacity among Rotaractors in grant management, application procedures, and compliance requirements.

To equip the club with practical tools for planning and implementing impactful community service projects.

To strengthen accountability and sustainability in future grant-funded initiatives.
details:
On June 13, 2025, members of the Rotaract Club of Metrocity actively participated in the Grant Management Seminar organized for Rotary Year 2025/26 at Ullens School, Lalitpur. The seminar served as a crucial capacity-building platform aimed at equipping Rotaractors with essential knowledge and practical skills for effective grant management and the successful implementation of community service projects.

The session provided a comprehensive understanding of Rotary grant opportunities, particularly District Grants and Global Grants. Facilitators offered detailed insights into grant eligibility criteria, application processes, compliance requirements, and best practices for securing and utilizing funds efficiently. The knowledge gained from this seminar has significantly strengthened the club’s ability to plan, execute, and sustain impactful community-based initiatives.
